name: Express Entry — Federal Skilled Trades Program (FSTP)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires 2 years of skilled-trades experience within the past 5 years, plus either a qualifying job offer (at least 1 year) or a certificate of qualification from a Canadian provincial/territorial authority.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a qualifying job offer or provincial trade certification.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires CLB 5 for speaking/listening, CLB 4 for reading/writing.
requirements.fix_path: Take an approved language test at the required level.

evidence_required.document: Certificate of qualification or a qualifying job offer

sources.title: Federal Skilled Trades Program eligibility - IRCC

notes: GENUINELY THIN 2026 ACTIVITY confirmed: no dedicated FSTP-specific or trades-category draw appears in the most recent official Express Entry rounds window at the time of the underlying research — a real and notable gap for a program that nominally exists year-round, worth flagging rather than assuming normal activity. Cooks were removed from the trades category-based draw list for 2026 — a real, specific occupation-level change. The smallest-volume of the three Express Entry sub-programs in this dataset by confirmed 2026 draw activity, in sharp contrast to ca_express_entry_cec's dominant share.
